t: Did he not swear me allegiance after the killing of `Uthman ? Now I do not need his allegiance, because his is the hand of a Jew. If he swears me allegiance with his hand he would violate it after a short while. Well, he is to get power for so long as a dog licks his nose. He is the father of four rams " who will also rule ". The people will face hard days through him and his sons.
